functions.name: scanUtf8
functions.signature: (type $t10) (param i32 i32 i32 i32 i32) (result i32)
functions.notes: Scans complete UTF-8 sequences from start to end under a UTF-16 code-unit budget and returns bytes consumed; invalid/truncated sequences stop before consumption.

validation.comparison: All 256 single bytes, lead/second/third/fourth class cross-products, every prefix and budgets 0-4 for five strings, budget 0xffffffff and 100 random strings compare return, complete memory and stack pointer.
limitations: Out-of-bounds/invalid pointer ranges are not exercised.
Ledger: 248 server bodies recovered and 487 remain machine code.
